newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo naphtha little changed ahead of Brent expiry.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo naphtha little changed ahead of Brent expiry.

text.p: Tokyo naphtha was little changed in subdued afternoon trade on Wednesday as both buyers and sellers backed away from the market ahead of the expiry of November Brent crude contract later in the day, traders said.
"Players were hesitant about taking up positions ahead of the expiry of November Brent," one trader said.
Open-spec naphtha for second-half December was nominally assessed at $221.00/$222.00, virtually unchanged from late Tuesday's levels.
In inter-month spreads, first-half December/first-half January was discussed at plus $1.50/$2.50 after it was exchanged at plus $2.00 on Tuesday.

In physical naphtha trading, most petrochemical end-users in Chiba, where one-third of Japan's ethylene plants are located, have satisfied their requirements for second-half November, traders said. They are expected to start working on December delivery cargoes next week, traders added.
Levels for first-half December caroges were assessed widely at 50 cents to $1.00 over the mean of Japanese quotes.
